implemented: Conservative wet shallow-water 2D Rusanov finite volume with periodic/wall/outflow boundary flux ledger
Scalar advection-diffusion2D positivity CFL, source ledger and exact continuum/discrete Fourier references
Weighted linear unimolecular stiff conversion networks, implicit M-matrix solve, per-edge mass ledger
Adaptive local reaction step doubling and first-order 2D transport/reaction splitting
Deterministic numerical schedule replay and tamper-rejecting split-run replay
Temporal refinement diagnostics and mesh overflow regressions
limits: Flat bed and strictly wet bounded shallow-water states; no wetting/drying, topography or turbulence
Scalar constant-coefficient common-species transport on Cartesian uniform grids only
First-order linear conversions only; no nonlinear chemistry, energy model or thermodynamic validation
Symmetric operator ordering remains first order because component methods are first order
Local error indicators and refinement differences are not rigorous global error enclosures
Mathematical and manufactured validation only; no experimental validation
Floating-point ill-conditioned implicit reaction systems may be rejected rather than corrected
